query:
SELECT c.key,
               c.enabled,
               COALESCE(l.description_en, c.description, '') AS description,
               COALESCE(l.label_en, initcap(replace(replace(c.key, '_', ' '), '-', ' '))) AS label
        FROM url_categories c
        LEFT JOIN url_category_labels l ON l.key = c.key
        ORDER BY c.key ASC
